resources.string: Identify a plant from a photo and explore its care guide.
This early build shows the app layout only. Taking or choosing a photo will be added next.
PlantID works with a small set of common indoor plants. It can\'t identify every plant.
Your identified plants will appear here. Start by identifying your first plant.
PlantID helps you identify selected common indoor plants from a photo and explore their care guide.
PlantID is being built for an academic research project. It supports a limited set of plants, and its results are not a guarantee.
The list of supported plants will appear here once the project team has confirmed it.
PlantID does not need an account and does not use the internet. This version does not take, store or upload any photos.
